_comment: Publication schedule. Each entry ships on its date. Pages live in answers/ but are absent from sitemap.xml, answers/index.html and llms.txt until published. cmd-tab-skips-minimized-windows was pulled on 2026-09-12: the cannibalization screen found it shares the H2 'The Option trick' with a live page and duplicates its coverage. See docs/cannibalization-audit-2026-09-12.md.

pages.title: Best Mac apps for 8GB of RAM
pages.blurb: On a base-model Mac the apps you add matter more than the apps you run. Eleven light native apps, with the memory cost of each stated honestly.

pages.title: Why does clicking a Dock icon bring all windows to the front?
pages.blurb: Because the Dock activates an application, not a window. What the click does, the four native ways to reach one window, and where each stops working.

pages.title: Best Mac apps under $10
pages.blurb: Twelve Mac apps that cost under ten dollars or nothing, with the exact price in every heading and four free picks that beat paid rivals.

pages.title: Shortcut to toggle between windows of the same app on Mac
pages.blurb: Command and backtick is the real answer and it works. Here are its three genuine limits, and the case where identical windows defeat it.

pages.title: Why do all Chrome profiles share one Dock icon on Mac?
pages.blurb: Because the Dock gives one tile per process and every Chrome profile runs in the same process. Four workarounds, and what each really costs.

pages.title: Keyboard shortcut to restore a minimized window on Mac
pages.blurb: Hold Option while releasing Command-Tab and macOS restores one minimized window. Why it ignores them otherwise, and what to do with several.

pages.title: Best Mac apps to keep work and personal separate
pages.blurb: Separating work from personal on one Mac is an identity problem, not an app problem. Six approaches, ranked by how much they actually separate.

pages.title: What separate Chrome instances actually cost on a Mac
pages.blurb: We measured it. Three profiles in one Chrome used 1.67 GB across 11 processes. The same three as separate instances used about 4.6 GB across 33.

pages.title: How to add spacers and separators between Dock icons
pages.blurb: One Terminal command adds a blank space to the Dock. The command, what each part does, how to remove a spacer, and the narrow variant.
